text:
deploy-bot: Canary rc-2026-06-12-2 finished deploy to canary-usw2. Post-deploy smoke running: prefiller_v4 (150 samples). Observed brief p95 bump +170ms and synthetic heartbeat drop 0.9%. tagging #eng-releases :triage_lights:

tia: seeing alerts. is this on the new quant-8-pack? @ollie

ollie: yes, quant8-13b. quick peek: a small subset of synth requests show doubled end tokens ("\n\n"). traces attached to thread.

sre-chen: doubled tokens = KV misalign + tail. can we temporarily throttle synth to protect prod?

tia: throttling synth to 12rps via deploy-bot now.

deploy-bot: synth-rate set=12 for canary-usw2. verification window 2m starting.

qa-kim: repro (local): `for i in 1..200; do curl -sS -X POST https://canary.api.redwood/v1/prefill -d '{\"prompt\":\"hi\"}'; done` — spikes when run concurrent.

ollie: logs show replacement char U+FFFD in tokenizer for some inputs; those requests hit fallback kernels and CPU spikes.

sre-chen: options: 1) rollback canary 2) divert synth to float16 3) keep low synth. prefer divert synth to collect safe traces.

tia: agree. prepare route synth-divert-0612 -> float16-13b. increase tracing for synth to 100% for 5m.

deploy-bot: Applied route synth-divert-0612 -> float16-13b. tracing=100% for canary-synth.

qa-kim: after diversion, synth p95 back to baseline and no replacement chars in samples. :white_check_mark:

ollie: filing INF-2026-318. summary: quant8 tokenizer emitting replacement chars for some utf8 sequences causing kernel fallback and tail latency. assigning to ollie. attaching repro and traces.

sre-chen: rollout paused. keep synth diverted for 24h and run expanded regression harness overnight. add auto-divert guard: if synth p95 > baseline+120ms for 3m, reroute synth automatically.

tia: guard created and runbook updated. closing loop: rollout paused, synth diverted, ticket INF-2026-318. thanks team. :thumbsup:
